_comment: What can be seen from across an abyss -- see `DeepLights`, which draws every one of these as an
unfogged point of light out to 120 blocks.
**A tag rather than a list in code, because which blocks are beacons is a content decision.** The sea
lantern seeds it and an ocean monument is therefore a constellation for free; the deep-sea material
joins here when it exists, and so does anything a pack wants to navigate by.
**Everything here draws IDENTICALLY, and that is the whole design.** An ore cluster, a monument and a
hunter's lure are one point of light at range, so approaching any of them is a decision taken without
knowing which it is. Adding something here that should be safe to approach weakens that -- the tag is
for things worth crossing an abyss to reach, not for lighting.
